title: NASA figured out how to keep its Voyager 2 probe running for another year
summary: NASA engineers have found a way to extend the operational life of the 48-year-old Voyager 2 spacecraft, allowing it to continue its interstellar mission for at least another year. The team addressed power management challenges by implementing strategic software updates and optimizing energy consumption across aging systems.
problem_solved: Keeping the 48-year-old Voyager 2 probe operational despite degrading power systems and aging hardware in deep space.
why_valuable: Extending Voyager 2's mission saves billions in potential replacement mission costs while continuing to gather unprecedented data from interstellar space.
